item.title: Festival Canceled: Sick New World 2025 Won’t Happen
item.description: Looks like Sick New World 2025 is joining the growing list of festivals that never make it past the announcement phase. Scheduled for April 12, 2025, in Las Vegas, this highly-hyped event has been officially scrapped.

item.title: Sick New World 2025 Lineup Announced: Metallica, Linkin Park & More
item.description: Sick New World 2025 is coming in hard, and this lineup is anything but subtle. Let’s cut to the chase—Metallica and Linkin Park are headlining. What? Metallica showing up at a festival that usually leans nü-metal?

item.title: James Hetfield: "We Don’t Want to Be a Legacy Band That Only Plays Hits"
item.description: METALLICA’s James Hetfield has made it pretty clear that they’re not interested in simply coasting on past glories. In an interview on “The Metallica Report”—that podcast where the band gives you a peek behind the curtain—James laid it out.

item.title: Metallica Confirms 2025 Headline Tour with Iconic Support Acts
item.description: Metallica is rolling out a 2025 North American tour, bringing their mix of old-school riffs and new album jams to a lineup that includes Sick New World and Sonic Temple festivals.

item.title: Did Slipknot’s Website Just Confirm Their New Drummer?
item.description: Slipknot’s grand reveal of their mystery drummer is just days away, set to coincide with their live performance at Sick New World. But a few determined internet detectives might have already beaten the band to the punch.
